_notice: Small sample reference data: a doctor or pharmacist must review before real use. Do not claim they are complete.

pediatricLimits.warning: Pediatric Paracetamol exceeds weight-based safe threshold (15 mg/kg single or 60 mg/kg daily).
Pediatric Amoxicillin dose exceeds recommended weight-based ceiling (50 mg/kg/day).
Pediatric Ibuprofen dose exceeds recommended pediatric weight-based limit (30 mg/kg/day).

doseLimits.warning: Exceeding 4000 mg/day of Paracetamol poses severe risk of acute hepatotoxicity.
Amoxicillin doses above 3000 mg/day exceed maximum recommended outpatient threshold.
High-dose Aspirin increases gastrointestinal bleeding and salicylate toxicity risk.
Warfarin daily dose exceeding 15 mg significantly increases life-threatening hemorrhage risk.
Ibuprofen daily dose exceeding 2400 mg increases GI bleeding and cardiovascular risk.
Metformin dose exceeding 2550 mg/day increases risk of lactic acidosis.
Amlodipine dose above 10 mg/day increases risk of peripheral edema and hypotension.
